Lucknow Development Authority Undertakes Major Infrastructure Drive to Resolve Waterlogging and Upgrade Roads

31 Oct 2026, 06:32 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: navbharattimes.indiatimes.com

Overview of the Inspection Drive

The Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) has initiated a comprehensive infrastructure and development drive across multiple zones in the city. Prathamesh Kumar, Vice Chairman of the LDA, conducted an extensive on-site inspection of key projects, including the Nadarganj Industrial Area, the Atal Nagar residential scheme in Devpur Para, and the upcoming Varun Vihar scheme near the Agra Expressway. During the visits, officials and engineers were directed to accelerate construction progress while strictly adhering to quality benchmarks and established deadlines.

Key Infrastructure Projects and Road Widening

A central focus of the recent inspections is the improvement of connectivity and drainage in the Nadarganj Industrial Area. According to official updates, the route from Nadarganj to T.S. Mishra University is being expanded to an 18-meter width. To combat chronic waterlogging issues in the area, the project includes the construction of deep RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) drains alongside interlocking pathways on both sides of the road.

As part of the road widening alignment, portions of the Kanha Upvan boundary and main gate fall within the construction zone. Authorities have planned for these structures to be temporarily removed and reconstructed upon completion of the road works. Additionally, priority has been assigned to constructing a security boundary for the Kapila Gaushala located within the Kanha Upvan premises.

Housing Scheme Updates: Atal Nagar and Varun Vihar

Progress is also underway in the residential sectors:

  • Atal Nagar (Devpur Para): The LDA Vice Chairman reviewed the hand-over process for MMIG flats to registered allottees and ordered expedited procedures. Preparations are underway to conduct a lottery for 208 LIG-1 category flats shortly. Ongoing work includes shifting electrical poles, developing park roads and green belts, and enhancing fire safety systems. Finishing work on the Rajnigandha Tower has been given a 15-day completion deadline, alongside the accelerated construction of a multi-level car parking facility for MIG residents.
  • Varun Vihar (Near Agra Expressway): During the assessment of land leveling, plot development, and cleaning initiatives, directives were issued to raise the land level by approximately one foot using soil filling to prevent future waterlogging. Proper technical management for water drainage, along with plot demarcation and cleaning along a 1.5-kilometer stretch of road, has been mandated.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For residents, property allottees, and business owners in Lucknow, these updates signal potential improvements in civic infrastructure, reduced waterlogging risks, and better traffic flow once the projects reach completion.

  • What is Confirmed: The LDA has officially issued directives regarding the 18-meter road widening from Nadarganj to T.S. Mishra University, the upcoming lottery for 208 LIG flats in Atal Nagar, and soil-filling requirements in Varun Vihar to mitigate waterlogging.
  • What Remains Unknown: Exact final completion dates for every individual sub-project and the precise schedule date for the LIG flat lottery were not fully detailed beyond immediate operational targets and 15-day deadlines for specific finishing tasks.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the original official announcement and ongoing civic updates via the [Navbharat Times Report](https://navbharattimes.indiatimes.com/state/uttar-pradesh/lucknow/lda-vice-chairman-inspected-nadarganj-atal-nagar-and-varun-vihar-schemes-reviewed-development-works/articleshow/135301224.cms) or through official Lucknow Development Authority portals.
